question: When every app can do the same clever trick, what makes your work truly valuable?
reflection: As tools become common to everyone, human insight, trust and care become the rarest and most valuable gifts.

sources.subject: Nous Hermes in Teams, Gemini 4 Neon API, OpenAI GPT-Live-1.1
AI's First Extinction Event Is Here

one_line: AI features are turning into free buttons inside big platforms, so the lasting value is moving to data, relationships and real-world know-how.

top_stories.title: AI startups face their first wave of extinction
top_stories.what: Forward Future argues that many AI products are dying as their main feature gets built into ChatGPT, Gemini and similar platforms, or as costs outrun revenue.
top_stories.why: A consultancy should not build thin AI tools; its defensible assets are local data, field-experiment skills, trusted relationships and cultural knowledge.

top_stories.title: Agents move into the chat tools teams already use
top_stories.what: Nous Research launched Hermes Enterprise, an open-source agent that works inside Microsoft Teams, can run inside a company's own Azure account, and saves a team's best workflows as reusable skills.
top_stories.why: Agents that live inside existing tools and stay inside an organisation's own cloud are the kind public-sector bodies can actually approve.

top_stories.title: Cheaper voice agents that pause when callers go quiet
top_stories.what: OpenAI made its GPT-Live-1.1 voice model available to developers, with a standby mode that reportedly cuts the cost of silent call time by about 60%.
top_stories.why: Lower idle costs make AI-run phone surveys and service lines more realistic, which opens up research on how people respond to an AI interviewer.

saudi_lens.text: Self-hosted agents such as Hermes running inside an organisation's own cloud fit Saudi data-residency expectations, where sensitive government data must stay in the Kingdom.
As AI features get bundled into global platforms, Saudi value is more likely to come from Arabic-first services, local data and adoption programmes than from copying generic AI apps.

idea.title: AI interviewer versus human interviewer
idea.pitch: Run the same short phone survey with an AI voice agent and with human interviewers, and compare completion rates, honesty on sensitive questions and respondent satisfaction.
idea.fit: Survey-heavy public bodies, culture sector, health
idea.first_step: Pick a 5-question survey you already run and list which questions might be answered differently to a machine.

terms.definition: An AI system that carries out tasks step by step on your behalf, such as searching, filling in forms or drafting documents, rather than only answering questions.
Software that runs on an organisation's own servers or cloud account, so its data does not pass through the vendor's systems.
When a large platform adds a feature for free that smaller companies were selling on its own, often putting those companies out of business.

concepts.summary: Standalone AI products are being absorbed or replaced by features inside big platforms.
AI agents that work inside Teams, Slack and meetings as shared team members.
AI that holds spoken conversations on calls, now cheap enough for surveys and service lines.
Keeping data and AI processing inside national borders and under national rules.
